description_en: Submits an asynchronous video translation task that supports subtitle translation, voice translation, main subtitle erasure, and on-screen text translation
description_zh: 提交异步视频翻译任务，支持字幕翻译、声音翻译、主字幕擦除和画面文字翻译
kebab_example: aliyun yike submit-video-translation-job --job-type VoiceTranslate --input VideoMediaId_:_media-video-001 --job-parameters SourceLanguage_:_zh_,_TargetLanguage_:_en_,_NeedDetext_:false,_NeedVisualTranslate_:false --api-version 2026-07-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitVideoTranslationJob

parameters.help_en: The job type. SubtitleTranslate indicates subtitle translation. VoiceTranslate indicates voice translation
parameters.help_zh: 任务类型。SubtitleTranslate 表示字幕翻译，VoiceTranslate 表示声音翻译
parameters.name: job_type

parameters.help_en: The input configuration JSON string. You must specify either Video or VideoMediaId, but not both. You can specify at most one of Audio or AudioMediaId. Subtitle is optional
parameters.help_zh: 输入配置 JSON 字符串。Video 与 VideoMediaId 必须且只能填写一个；Audio 与 AudioMediaId 最多填写一个；可选填写 Subtitle
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en: The output configuration JSON string. OssUri is an optional customer OSS output directory. If not specified, a signed URL of the service-owned artifact is returned
parameters.help_zh: 输出配置 JSON 字符串。OssUri 为可选的客户 OSS 输出目录；未指定时返回服务自有产物的签名 URL
parameters.name: output

parameters.help_en: The job parameters JSON string. It must contain at least SourceLanguage and TargetLanguage. You can also configure main subtitle erasure, voice translation, on-screen text translation, and final editing
parameters.help_zh: 任务参数 JSON 字符串，至少包含 SourceLanguage 和 TargetLanguage，并可配置主字幕擦除、声音翻译、画面文字翻译及最终剪辑
parameters.name: job_parameters

parameters.help_en: The job title. If not specified, the service generates a default title
parameters.help_zh: 任务标题。未填写时由服务生成默认标题
parameters.name: title

parameters.example: 将中文产品介绍视频翻译为英文。
parameters.help_en: The job description, used to record business purposes or processing requirements
parameters.help_zh: 任务说明，用于记录业务用途或处理要求
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The custom user data JSON string. It can contain the asynchronous notification address NotifyAddress
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义数据 JSON 字符串，可包含异步通知地址 NotifyAddress
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en: The user-level idempotency token, up to 40 characters. If the same user submits a request with the same token, the original job is returned
parameters.help_zh: 用户维度的幂等令牌，最长 40 个字符。相同用户使用同一令牌重复提交时返回原任务
parameters.name: client_token

JobId.description_en: The video translation job ID, used to call GetVideoTranslationJob to query the job
JobId.description_zh: 视频翻译任务 ID，用于调用 GetVideoTranslationJob 查询任务

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, used for Tracing Analysis and troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于链路追踪和问题排查
